messages:
maria: Incoming pentest scheduled for Tue 5/12 — need final scope, RBAC change plan, KMS access window, and audit log retention. Vendor requested read-only access to evidence S3 prefix. Can we lock times and approvers? Need answers by EOD Fri.

jamal: Proposed assessor window 2026-05-12 09:00–17:00 PDT. Provide ephemeral STS AssumeRole. @sam can you review and approve the role? Also we should enable CloudTrail data events + object-level logging for the window.

sam: I can approve the STS role in principle. Please paste the exact IAM policy you plan to attach — prefer to avoid iam:PassRole. For audit logs, 90 days retention is our standard, but check contractual 180d requirement.

lee: KMS notes — we can create a temporary CMK with a key policy that limits use to the assessor role and our ops account. Recommend disabling external key rotation during the window and schedule a scheduled deletion hold after retest. Question: does vendor need KMS Decrypt, or can we provide pre-signed S3 GETs for encrypted objects? Decrypt rights increase surface.

maria: Vendor only needs read of the packaged evidence (gz files). Plan suggestion: 1) create assessor role with AssumeRole + external ID 12345, 2) generate STS creds scoped to S3 GetObject for s3://redwood-pt-evidence/pt-4292/*, 3) upload manifest + presigned URLs, 4) enable CloudTrail data events for S3 + send to s3://redwood-pt-logs/pt-4292/, 5) set log retention to 180d unless we decide 90d. Sample IAM snippet for the role:

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["s3:GetObject"],
      "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence/pt-4292/*"]
    }
  ]
}
```

Is 180d mandatory for compliance? If so we'll do 180.

jamal: Legal asked for 180d for external assessments, but ops prefers 90d for cost. Compromise: set 180d but separate the storage tier so we can lifecycle to cheaper storage after 30 days. That satisfies legal + ops.

sec-bot: Deploy bot created checklist ticket PT-4292 and attached initial scope doc: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/PT-4292 — checklist includes: RBAC policy, temp CMK, manifest upload, presigned URL packaging, dry-run.

oncall: On-call note — we'll add runbook triggers for: high KMS GenerateDataKey/Decrypt rate, unusual AssumeRole principals, and >1k S3 GETs/hour. I can staff watch during 09:00–18:00 PDT for the window. If vendor causes memcached or autoscale spikes we'll mute auto-scale alerts but keep oncall notified.

maria: Action items for EOD Fri: @sam attach approved IAM policy to PT-4292, @lee create temp KMS key & key policy, @jamal prepare manifest + upload, @oncall add alert runbook. I'll consolidate vendor instructions and external ID. Dry-run Friday 16:00 PT to validate presigned links and STS flow. :thumbsup:

sam: Approved. I'll upload the policy to the ticket and note the avoidance of iam:PassRole.

jamal: Manifest uploaded to s3://redwood-pt-evidence/pt-4292/manifest.json. Generating presigned URLs now; will share in the secure doc.

maria: Thanks all — if dry-run goes green we keep the retest window. Please flag any blockers ASAP.
